title: Inspection of solid fuel-burning heating appliances, chimneys and flues.
officialText:
Inspections of solid fuel-burning heating appliances, chimneys and flues shall be in accordance with the New York City Building Code.
*Section 901.6 was amended by Local Law 38 of 2015. This law has an effective date of May 6, 2016.
